derivation: neuter of a presumed compound of G4314 (πρός) and G2776 (κεφαλή);
def: something for the head, i.e. a cushion

occurrences.text: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
